item.title: Iran's war against the US and Israel is being fueled by North Korean weapons, expert warns
item.summary: Iran's ballistic missiles, including the Shahab-3 and Khorramshahr-4, were developed with North Korean help, says expert Bruce Bechtol, who urges stronger sanctions enforcement.

item.title: AI war in Iran has brought conflict to Silicon Valley. No one is ready
item.summary: Iran published a 29-location target list naming Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Nvidia and Palantir, then struck AWS data centers in the UAE and Bahrain.

item.title: Trump dominates CPAC poll as conservatives rally behind agenda, back Iran action
item.summary: A new CPAC survey finds strong conservative backing for Trump's agenda, with 91% supporting tariffs and 89% backing military action in Iran.

item.title: Rand Paul says he's '50-50' on running for president in 2028, 'thinking about it'
item.summary: Sen. Rand Paul, R-Ky., told "CBS News Sunday Morning" that he is "50-50" on a possible 2028 presidential run based on his opposition to the war against Iran.

item.title: Insurgent Virginia Democrat says his party is ‘completely wrong’ on gun rights and gerrymandering
item.summary: Democratic primary challenger Mark Moran says his party is "completely wrong" on gun rights, sparking backlash from Virginia Democrats over his Second Amendment stance.

item.title: Dem senator warns deportation could let Virginia woman's illegal immigrant killer 'escape accountability'
item.summary: Sen. Tim Kaine says Abdul Jalloh, charged with murdering Stephanie Minter in Virginia, should be fully prosecuted before any deportation to ensure accountability.

item.title: Lionel Richie issues warning to rude celebrities after Chappell Roan backlash
item.summary: Lionel Richie warns rising stars to embrace fan support, saying fame without people "doesn't work," amid Chappell Roan's Brazil fan incident controversy.

item.title: Trump claims donor-funded White House ballroom includes hidden build below with security focus
item.summary: A $400 million White House ballroom approved by the Commission of Fine Arts will include an underground complex, Trump says, funded by private donors.

item.title: Rob Schneider proposes military draft, urges Americans to 'recommit' to traditional values
item.summary: Actor Rob Schneider invoked a JFK quote on X while calling for restoring the military draft, urging every American to serve two years of service at 18.

item.title: More and more Gen Z women say they don’t want kids. As a young mom, here’s what they get wrong
item.summary: As a Gen Z mom, I've found motherhood's challenges yield more joy than sacrifice—despite social media's DINK glamorization discouraging young women.
